body: Adversarial review round 1 (codex) found extractAgySection matches a version as an unbounded prefix: requesting 1.4.7 can select a 1.4.70 heading, so the trust-anchor attestation and the audit could hash the wrong release section. Fix in skills/modernize/scripts/audit.mjs and skills/modernize/scripts/trust-anchor.mjs (both copies must stay identical in behaviour): the markdown heading match must require a version-token boundary (not followed by an alphanumeric or by a dot-digit), fail closed (null) when no exact section exists. HTML id matching is already exact (closing quote). Add regression tests in test/trust-anchor.test.mjs distinguishing 1.4.7 from 1.4.70 and 1.4.7.1, including the audit.mjs parity. Sync skill mirrors with npm run skills:sync. Acceptance: npm test green; the new tests fail without the fix.
title: Exact version boundary in the release-section extractor
